long_biography.plain_text:
When Stanislav Enikeev and his partners tested their pizza concept in Moscow, they initially kept the Zotman name off the sign. Customers assembled their own toppings at a fixed price; the experiment gained regulars before the established brand appeared above the door. The approach put customers' choices at the centre of a business intended for a mass market.

Enikeev's commercial task extended beyond opening restaurants. The team used partially baked, frozen bases to make consistent pizza without requiring a specialist dough maker in every kitchen. Pandemic restrictions brought delivery forward, prompting collaborations with other operators' kitchens alongside dedicated delivery outlets. The business later added finished frozen pizzas for home baking, reducing its dependence on meals arriving hot.
long_biography.html:
When Stanislav Enikeev and his partners tested their pizza concept in Moscow, they initially kept the Zotman name off the sign. Customers assembled their own toppings at a fixed price; the experiment gained regulars before the established brand appeared above the door. The approach put customers' choices at the centre of a business intended for a mass market.

Enikeev's commercial task extended beyond opening restaurants. The team used partially baked, frozen bases to make consistent pizza without requiring a specialist dough maker in every kitchen. Pandemic restrictions brought delivery forward, prompting collaborations with other operators' kitchens alongside dedicated delivery outlets. The business later added finished frozen pizzas for home baking, reducing its dependence on meals arriving hot.
